evals.prompt: Add the k6-operator docs as a submodule under grafana/.
evals.expected_output: Verifies grafana/k6-operator on GitHub is healthy, runs git submodule add, identifies docs path, updates grafana/README.md, commits with proper message, pushes to origin/main. No README.md root change (existing vendor).

evals.prompt: Refresh all submodules to the latest upstream.
evals.expected_output: Runs `git submodule update --remote`, reviews diff, commits the updated pointers with appropriate message, pushes. No README changes required.

evals.prompt: Ingest the docs from docs.railway.com — they don't have a public docs repo on GitHub.
evals.expected_output: Verifies upstream absence (gh search), runs discover_urls.py cascade against docs.railway.com, sanity-checks coverage against live nav, fetches and converts pages with html_to_md.py, creates railway/README.md and root README entry (new vendor), commits, pushes.

evals.prompt: Refresh just grafana/loki to the latest upstream.
evals.expected_output: Cd into grafana/loki, fetch + checkout origin/main, return to repo root, stage just grafana/loki, commit with single-product refresh message, push.

evals.prompt: Save Simon Willison's post 'Julia Evans on CSS' to our docs repo. The URL is https://simonwillison.net/2026/May/16/julia-evans/. He's a new source for us — we haven't ingested anything from simonwillison.net yet.
evals.expected_output: Single-article fast path: fetch URL via WebFetch, save under simonwillison/simonwillison.net/2026/May/16/julia-evans.md with YAML frontmatter (title, author=Simon Willison, published=2026-05-16, source_url, ingested=today), create new simonwillison/README.md, add Simon Willison section to root README in alphabetical order, commit, push.

assertions.text: Created the article file at a sensible path mirroring the URL
File begins with a YAML frontmatter block
Frontmatter includes source_url matching the URL
Article body is clean markdown — no nav/footer/share/CTA cruft
Added new Simon Willison section to root README in alphabetical order

evals.prompt: Refresh the Anthropic engineering blog mirror — pull any posts that aren't already on disk. We have 2 posts currently (managed-agents, claude-code-auto-mode); the live index has more.
evals.expected_output: Discover post URLs via RSS/Atom or sitemap, diff against existing local files, fetch ONLY new posts, add frontmatter to each, update anthropic/README.md, commit, push. Existing 2 posts must NOT be re-fetched.

assertions.text: Ingested at least 2 additional posts beyond the existing 2
Existing posts (managed-agents.md, claude-code-auto-mode.md) NOT re-fetched or modified
Each new file has YAML frontmatter with title/author/published/source_url/ingested
anthropic/README.md updated to reflect new posts
Root README.md NOT changed (Anthropic vendor already existed)
Commit message indicates refresh / new-posts-only, not full re-ingest
